mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pinwheel was the most worthwhile step: it joined the earlier creation to the whale and revealed the completed assembly in motion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the clip was clear but less engaging on its own; it mainly prepared the mount for the pinwheel.

surprise.text: I did not expect the frame to rise and lower along with the turning pinwheel.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the goals named the parts and their connection.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see how the moving assembly is used, although this short chapter offered few decisions beyond following the instructions.
